query: Which objective ASR quality metrics (confidence, WER) and minimum thresholds should exclude low-quality transcripts from thematic analysis?

response.query: Which objective ASR quality metrics (confidence, WER) and minimum thresholds should exclude low-quality transcripts from thematic analysis?
response.answer: To exclude low-quality transcripts, use ASR metrics: WER < 20% and confidence > 0.75. These thresholds ensure high-quality transcriptions for thematic analysis.
